reuse.why: Adds the flag to the existing shared shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate that all six month-wide actions already call.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is relaxed in one expression in the predicate; the actions only forward the flag.

placement.why: The exclusion logic stays in budget/actions.ts's predicate, and the handler types pick up the argument through typeof actions.*.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the six month-wide actions' arguments and a focused test change.

maintainability.why: Clear and in one place; the same inline argument type is repeated six times and setZero's signature is squeezed onto one long line.
